ability.name: Collar of Contempt
ability.effect: This unit can use **^^Unbind^^** abilities as if it had **^^Wizard (1)^^**. Each time this unit successfully unbinds a spell, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster.

ability.name: Butcher's Blade
ability.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
ability.declare: Pick each enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit's combat attacks to be the targets.

ability.name: Ar'gath, the King of Blades
ability.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for enemy **^^Heroes^^** while they are in combat with this unit.
